Favor IRSX (semiconductor-linked) and PMUI (digital payments) as they track global AI capex and local consumption. Trim AMZN/MSFT-style mega-cap exposure; add IDX tech laggards with earnings revisions.

Energy transition capex and government subsidies for renewable mining operations create durable cost advantages for integrated players like INCO and TINS over pure exporters.

Trim US-exposed laggards, rotate into domestic commodity plays with strong cash flow and dividend yields.

Rotate out of US-exposed names (INDR, BACH) as IDR strength and domestic consumption hold. Target UNIC and OPMS for defensive yield; trim GZCO on valuation risk.
